about: Hand-maintained inputs for the Portfolio tab (scripts/sector-portfolio.py). history = every rebalance that changed the holdings (applied at that date's close); between them the portfolio is rebalanced back to its targets at the first close of each quarter. earnings = the latest reported quarter per stock (test 4 of the sector check). notes = optional one-sentence market context for a session in the daily commentary.

history.why: Initial portfolio: the best risk-adjusted stock in each sector that also fell least on Nasdaq down days.

Sector check: Visa replaced JPMorgan in financials after passing all four tests (12-month Sharpe 0.99 vs 0.27, lower downside capture, earnings beat vs JPMorgan's miss). Weights reset to target, topping TSM back up to 30%.

TSM.flag: Gross margin down 1.3 pts q/q on the 2nm ramp and overseas fabs; capex $60–64B

JNJ.eps: Adj. $2.59 (−7.5% on deal costs); est. $2.53. GAAP $0.09
JNJ.take: Innovative Medicine +7.7% offsetting Stelara's loss of exclusivity
JNJ.flag: $5.5B talc charge for a proposed, not final, resolution; MedTech only +2.5%

KO.guide: Raised: organic ≥5%, comparable EPS growth ≥11%, FCF ≥$13B
KO.take: Unit case volume +5%; comparable operating margin 32.9%
KO.flag: US volume flat; valuation already rich

XOM.guide: $20B buyback planned for 2027; dividend raised to $1.07
XOM.take: Refining earnings doubled q/q; free cash flow $19.1B
XOM.flag: Upstream earnings fell q/q on lower crude; profits lean on cyclical refining margins

V.flag: Operating expenses growing about as fast as revenue; $474M litigation provision

GE.flag: Quarterly free cash flow −14%; GE9X certification timing

JPM.take: Net interest income +13%; consumer bank net income +13%

LMT.take: Record $292B backlog incl. a $52.5B PAC-3 award
LMT.flag: Lot 20 contract costs now exceed authorized funding

notes.2026-11-04: Stocks had their best day in three months as midterm-election uncertainty cleared.
notes.2026-11-05: AI and chip stocks led a market-wide rout: the Nasdaq had its worst day since April 2025 and closed in correction territory after the midterm results raised doubts about the pace of the AI data-centre build-out.

study.text: Hindsight check (one-off study, Nov 2026): picking the sector winners with only the first year of data (Nov 2024–Nov 2025) and holding them through the second year returned +32% to +51% depending on the semis pick, against +9.9% for the Nasdaq, so the selection method held up out of sample. A walk-forward test that rotated sector winners every quarter on price data alone returned slightly less than holding (+72% vs +74% from May 2025), which is why a swap must pass all four tests.
